title: dropdown chooser
rule: For a bounded choice set, let the user pick from a drop-down chooser rather than typing the value from memory.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Drop-down Chooser (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Bounded set is picked from a drop-down (or equivalent chooser), not typed from memory.
fail_when: Bounded list is a blank the user must recall.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
